title: Detect changed configuration fields
prompt: Write changed(a,b), returning sorted names whose values differ or are absent on one side. Example: {'x':None} versus {} must report ['x'].
solution:
def changed(a,b):
    return sorted(k for k in set(a)|set(b) if k not in a or k not in b or a[k]!=b[k])
tests:
assert changed({'tables':'v1','timing':0},{'tables':'v1','timing':1})==['timing'], 'Identify the one changed factor'
assert changed({'x':None},{})==['x'], 'Absent and explicit None are different configurations'
assert changed({'x':1},{'x':1})==[], 'Identical configs have no changes'

title: Reject overlapping sets
prompt: Write fresh_ok(dev,fresh,inspected) returning True only if fresh is nonempty and shares no identifiers with dev or inspected. Example: fresh={'b'},dev={'a'},inspected={} passes.
tests:
assert fresh_ok({'a'},{'b'},set()), 'A nonempty untouched disjoint block is eligible'
assert not fresh_ok({'a'},{'a','b'},set()), 'Development overlap invalidates the block'
assert not fresh_ok(set(),{'b'},{'b'}), 'Inspected outcomes are not fresh'
assert not fresh_ok(set(),set(),set()), 'An empty block supplies no evidence'

title: Freeze the stopping rule
prompt: Write should_stop(completed,planned) returning completed >= planned. Example: 39 of 40 is False, 40 of 40 is True. Ignore whether the current score looks good.
tests:
assert not should_stop(39,40), 'Do not stop before the fixed plan completes'
assert should_stop(40,40) and should_stop(41,40), 'Stop at or beyond the planned count'

title: Plant a comparator defect
prompt: Write exact(recorded,simulated) comparing dictionaries with hp,x,y. All fields must match, including equality of dictionary contents. Example: a one-HP difference fails.
tests:
a={'hp':100,'x':4,'y':20}
assert exact(a,dict(a)), 'Identical observations must pass'
assert not exact(a,{'hp':99,'x':4,'y':20}), 'A planted one-HP defect must fail'
assert not exact(a,{'hp':100,'x':5,'y':20}), 'A coordinate defect must fail too'
hint: Dictionary equality compares names and values.
